# Dynamic_Expert_Fusion

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method where multiple specialized subnetworks (experts) are combined in real-time based on input features, rather than using a fixed ensemble or single network. Enables scalable, adaptive computation in both TCC and iNEST systems, balancing specialization and generalization while optimizing resource usage.
